Follow a source trail

Start with the invoice file and worksheet your provider sent. Ledger records the actual row number.

See the signed amount on the source record. Its receipt includes a SHA-256 checksum of the original file.

The workbook gives reviewers a fee rollup and a separate sheet of source references.
